name: Electrochemical Methods
description: Nernst equation and modified Nernst equation, Galvani potential, Butler-Volmer equation, Tafel equation. Potential step voltammetry, control voltage methods such as pulse voltammetry and cyclic voltammetry. Controlled current methods, current-interrupt measurements. Conductivity relaxation, impedance spectroscopy. Coulometric methods, scanning probe techniques, rotating disc electrode, rotating ring disc electrode, spectro-electrochemistry.
